*.patch -whitespace

handoff/positive-court/A3-bounded-artifa.reason: Only whitespace differences in earlier comparison; all bounded-header evidence facts already shared. No replacement or retrospective rewriting of historical draft/UNRUN statements.

excluded: replacement/normalization of historical raw evidence or source-only/UNRUN labels

application_boundary: No actual overlay performed. Eventual bundle must remain additive67 + absent attribute stanza + new report only. Recheck at final A0 docs/evidence commit if target ref advances; retain new Root contributions and never blanket-copy the A3 handoff directory.
